outlet: The Miner (Newport), "Pend Oreille Public Utility District Candidates, Position 2" (2026-07-22)
notes: PUD candidate questionnaire: Gerry David Bradbury, 52, educator, Newport; Newport School District teacher and coach 23 years, KUBS FM manager, former Priest River Junior High principal; praises the current board and management; top issue is renegotiating the Boundary Dam power agreement with Seattle City Light by 2030; concern about unfunded state and federal environmental mandates.
